content: Dawiti Sooretanne Amooneta Xoonis
Hessafe guye, Amooneta kawoy hayqin iya na7ay Hanuni iya bessan kawotis.
Dawiti, “Iya aaway taw keehidaysada Na7oosa na7aa Hanunas taka keehana” yaagis. Hessa gisho, iya minthethanaw Dawiti ase iyako kiittis. Dawiti kiitida asay Amoone biitta gakida wode,
Amoone halaqati banta godaa Hanunako, “Dawiti ha asaa kiittiday ne aawa bonchidi nena minthethanaw koyida gisho daanii? I ase kiittiday ha katamaa wochi be7idi olanaasa” yaagidosona.
Hanuni Dawiti kiitida asata oykidi, enta buuchaafe baggaa meedis; enta ma7uwa garsafe dulle gakanaw qanxidi enta yeddis.
Dawiti hessa si7idi, enti yeellatida gisho, “Hinte buuchay diccana gakanaw Iyaarkon de7ishite; hessafe guye, haa yiite” yaagidi ase kiittis.

Amooneti Dawiti enta morkidaysa erida wode Beet-Rehoobanne Suubban de7iya Araame asaape laatamu mukulu toho olanchota, Xoobape tammanne nam7u mukulu asatanne Maka kawuwape issi mukulu asata shammidosona.
Dawiti hessa si7ida wode Iyo7aaba kumetha olanchotara enta bolla yeddis.
Amooneti keyidi, katamaa pengiyan olas salpidosona; Suubbafenne Rehoobape yida Araame asati, Xooba asatinne Maka asati denban dumma salpidosona.
Iyo7aabi bana oli sintharanne guyera teqidaysa be7idi, Isra7eele olanchotape minota dooridi Soore asata sinthan essis.
Attida asata ba ishaa Abisi kiittana mela oothidi Amooneta sinthan salpisis.
Iyo7aabi Abisako, “Soore asati ta bolla wolqaamiko ne yada tana maadda; Amoone asati ne bolla wolqaamiko ta bada nena maaddana.
Hiza minna! Nu asaa gishonne nu Xoossaa katamata gisho, ane minni oletoos. Goday bana lo77iyaba ootho” yaagis.
Iyo7aabinne iyara de7iya olanchoti Soore asata olanaw keyidosona; Soore asati iya sinthafe baqatidosona.
Soore asati baqatidaysa Amoone asati be7ida wode entika Abisa sinthafe baqatidi, katama gelidosona. Iyo7aabi Amooneta oleysa aggidi, Yerusalaame simmis.
Soore asati Isra7eele asay enta xoonidaysa erida wode banta olanchota ubbaa shiishidosona.
Kawoy Hadadizeri Soore asata Efraxiisa Shaafa hefinthafe kiittidi ehisin, Elama bidosona. Adraazara tora moconay Shobaaki enta kaalethees.
Dawiti hessa si7ida wode, Isra7eele olanchota shiishidi, Yordaanose shaafa pinnidi Elama gakis. Soore asati besse oykidi, giigidi, Dawitara oletidosona.

Shin Soore asati Isra7eeleta sinthafe baqatidosona. Dawiti Soore olanchotape para gaare laagiya laapun xeetu asatanne oytamu mukulu toho olanchota wodhis. Enta toora mocona Sobaakika he bessan shocetidi hayqis.
Adrazaras haaretidi de7iya kawoti Isra7eeleti enta xoonidaysa erida wode Isra7eeletara sigetidi, entaw haaretidosona. Hessafe simmin, Soore asati Amoone asata maaddanaw yayyidosona.
